title: Reshoring American Manufacturing Act of 2026
committees: H-Small Business Committee: Referred To 2026-07-15 -> Markup By 2026-09-16 -> Reported By 2026-10-09
latest_action: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
summary: Reshoring American Manufacturing Act of 2026 This bill requires the Office of Manufacturing and Trade of the Small Business Administration (SBA) to establish and maintain a webpage with a list of resources and information related to onshoring to the United States all or part of the manufacturing capacity of small businesses. In general, onshoring involves transitioning the manufacture of goods by U.S. companies from overseas to domestic production. The webpage must include (1) contact information for relevant offices of the SBA and partner organizations, (2) a free tool designed to help small businesses identify entities that could assist with onshoring the business's manufacturing capacity, and (3) other information the office determines is appropriate.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
